messages.summary:
## Objective
- Continue from the existing project and finish ARCANA as a complete, playable game.

## Requirements
- Build without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them upon completion.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Assumed the existing ARCANA wizard battle royale is the game to finish; its maps, classes, controls, and mechanics are already implemented.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the existing game implementation, UI, and 3D scene.
- Ran `node --check game.js` and `node --check three-scene.js`; both passed.

### Active
- Validate gameplay in a browser and fix any issues found.

### Blocked
- Browser check did not run: Chromium aborted with `FATAL: ... No usable sandbox!`; retry with `--no-sandbox` or another available browser method.

## Next Move
1. Retry Chromium with `--no-sandbox` against `http://127.0.0.1:8000/index.html`.
2. Exercise start, gameplay controls, pause, win/loss, and replay; address any defects found.
3. Save and inspect a latest small JPEG screenshot, then summarize assumptions and verification.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Core gameplay, controls, combat, AI, rendering, state transitions.
- `index.html`: Game UI and controls.
- `style.css`: Game layout and responsive styling.
- `three-scene.js`: Three.js arena, characters, and effects.
- `three-scene.css`: 3D scene layering and canvas visibility.

## Important Context
- Existing local server was started with `python3 -m http.server 8000`; process ID was `4362`.
- Chromium command failed without sandbox override; no project files were modified during this session.

## Objective
- Finish ARCANA as a complete, playable game, continuing from the existing project without asking questions.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them upon completion.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG screenshot with viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

- Treat the existing ARCANA wizard battle royale, maps, classes, controls, and mechanics as the game to finish.

### Completed
- Inspected the existing game implementation, UI, and 3D scene.
- `node --check game.js` and `node --check three-scene.js` passed.

### Blocked

- `game.js`: Core gameplay, controls, combat, AI, rendering, and state transitions.

- `style.css`: Game layout and responsive styling.

## Important Context
- Local HTTP server was started with `python3 -m http.server 8000`; initial process ID was `4362`.
- Chromium was relaunched with remote debugging on port `9222`; browser interaction has not yet been exercised.
